title: 函数输出GO
problem_statement_md:
示例代码中调用了函数**talk**()，该函数应输出文本 "GO"。
在**main**()中调用了3次`talk()`，但缺少函数定义部分。

请添加代码来定义**talk**()函数，函数中输出"GO"。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Go![/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You are given code that includes calls to a function called "[b]talk()[/b]", which should output the text "[b]GO[/b]".
The function is called 3 times in [b]main[/b](), but the code is missing the function declaration.

Add the missing code to declare the [b]talk[/b]() function, which should output "[b]GO[/b]" to the screen.
[note]Note, that the output should be in all caps.[/note]

code_templates.template:
package main
import "fmt"

func main() {
    talk()
    talk()
    talk()
}
